name: field-type
body: Field type: text (inline Markdown, body inline rules; links validated like body links) | number (plain YAML number; strings are type errors) | date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) | boolean | enum | image | link | list (one item descriptor) | <section-template>. Every type may be `nullable` (nullable-fields). A list's `item:` descriptor may declare an inline `record` with its own `fields:` — `item: {type: record, fields: [...]}` (record-item-type).
